system_state_snapshot.recent_sales_summary: Aucune vente. Le systeme est en phase de mise en place des moteurs de production.
open_issues: Generation d'image: HF ne sert plus FLUX/SDXL gratuitement, Gemini image = 429 (payant), AI Horde bloque depuis les IP GitHub Actions (403). Seul Pollinations repond mais qualite brute.
Pistes image en cours: Together AI (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img) et Cloudflare Workers AI (gratuit 10k neurons/j) a tester; Runware en PAYG plafonne 20€ comme option qualite/volume.
Cerveaux: modele Gemini experimental deprecie corrige, fallback multi-modeles ajoute.

image_generation_status.pollinations: operationnel mais qualite brute, text2img sans image de reference
image_generation_status.together_ai: a tester (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + img2img, cle TOGETHER_API_KEY)
image_generation_status.cloudflare: a tester (gratuit, FLUX-schnell + SD img2img, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN + ACCOUNT_ID)
image_generation_status.runware: option payante PAYG plafonnee a 20€/mois (~33000 images FLUX-schnell)

system_state_snapshot.llm_brains_status: Gemini texte operationnel (cle posee), modele stable gemini-2.5-flash avec fallback
constraints: 100% gratuit privilegie; budget image max 20€/mois accepte

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $10-15 free credits upon registration. FLUX.1-schnell costs ~$0.0015 per generation, allowing ~6,000+ free high-quality images.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides an OpenAI-compatible API for state-of-the-art open-weights models including FLUX.1-schnell and FLUX.1-dev, with extreme speed and zero cold-start issues on GitHub Actions.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Can replace the failing Pollinations/AI Horde image generators in `produce_coloring_book` and `produce_kdp_cover` via a simple python `openai` client wrapper.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires credit card verification to unlock the trial credits in some regions, though no immediate charges apply.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 1,000,000 free tokens per month via simple GET requests.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts any web URL (including complex e-commerce or trend pages) into clean, LLM-friendly Markdown. No headless browser needed in GitHub Actions.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Used in `agent_trendhunter` and `agent_opportunity_hunter` to scrape Etsy trend pages, competitor listings, or blog posts directly into Gemini's context.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Target sites with aggressive Cloudflare protection might occasionally block Jina's proxy IPs.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: No monthly fees. 5% + 50c per transaction. Unlimited hosting of digital files.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Acts as a Merchant of Record (MoR). They handle EU/French VAT calculation, collection, and remittance automatically, which is a massive legal relief for a French solo entrepreneur.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Storefront for selling direct PDF coloring books, SVG packs, and gamedev assets. Can be linked from social media or GitHub Pages.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Payout thresholds apply, and payout fees can cut into micro-transactions if not optimized.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: $1.80 free trial credits. FLUX.1-schnell is priced at $0.0015/image, yielding ~1,200 free images.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Extremely low-latency API offering FLUX, SDXL, and LLMs (like Llama-3) under a single API key with pay-as-you-go pricing that is far cheaper than Together AI or Runware once free credits run out.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Backup API in `image_generation_status` to ensure reliable image generation pipelines when Cloudflare or Together AI fail.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires monitoring of credit balance to prevent silent pipeline failures in GitHub Actions.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to upload unlimited 3D models. Built-in membership and direct sales features with low platform fees.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The fastest-growing 3D model search engine and community. Highly optimized for STL files and parametric 3D printing designs.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Target marketplace for pipelines like `produce_stl_parametric`, listing alongside Cults3D to double organic reach.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Highly competitive for generic models; designs must be highly functional or niche-specific to stand out.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free to format and distribute. They take a 10% cut of the retail price only upon actual sales.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Distributes ebooks and paperbacks (including low-content/coloring books) to Apple Books, Kobo, Barnes & Noble, and Tolino simultaneously from a single upload.
proposals.would_integrate_where: An expansion step after `produce_coloring_book` or `produce_chess_book` to diversify away from exclusive reliance on Amazon KDP.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Formatting requirements for multi-platform paperback distribution can be stricter than Amazon KDP's print specs.
